headline: Most Pharma Companies Don't Realize How Much Expense Inefficiency Is Costing Them
intro: The pain is real. The losses are compounding. And most organizations won't see it — until it's too late.

mrExpensesLabel: Every day, your Medical Representatives spend their own money on:

oldTools.name: Spreadsheets
oldTools.desc: Version conflicts, formula errors, zero real-time visibility across your field teams.

oldTools.name: Email Chains
oldTools.desc: Approval requests buried in inboxes. Days of back-and-forth with zero tracking.

oldTools.name: WhatsApp Groups
oldTools.desc: Informal approvals, no audit trail. A compliance team's worst nightmare.

oldTools.name: Lengthy Approvals
oldTools.desc: Paper trails, human errors, weeks of delay before a rep sees any reimbursement.

result.headline: Your business is silently bleeding
result.subtext: And it compounds — month after month — while you're focused on growing revenue.

problems.label: Reimbursements get delayed
problems.body: MRs wait weeks for money they've already spent from their own pockets — quietly demotivating your frontline.

problems.label: Employees become frustrated
problems.body: Your best field talent walks out the door when they feel financially invisible and administratively stuck.

problems.label: Finance teams get overwhelmed
problems.body: Lengthy reconciliation consumes dozens of hours each month — hours that should be spent on growth.

problems.label: Managers lose visibility
problems.body: No real-time dashboard. No spend control. Decisions made blind while the budget silently erodes.

problems.label: Duplicate claims go unnoticed
problems.body: Without automation, the same expense can slip through and get reimbursed twice — every single month.

problems.label: Compliance risks increase
problems.body: One audit can expose months of untracked, undocumented spending. The penalties aren't worth the risk.

closing.headline: Most of these issues remain invisible — until they hit profitability and morale.
closing.body: By the time you notice, the damage is done. Competitors on modern expense management are already pulling ahead.
